column2: [intro]
It's my computer, a true magician,
When it starts up, everything lights up, it's divine,
I'm connected, I travel endlessly,
In the virtual world, I'm in uncharted seas.
All these gadgets that create dopamine,
They spin my head, they put me in a trance,
I give them all my love, these little machines,
When they come to life, it's a party that begins.
Ah, my smartphone, always glued to my hand,
I scroll through my feed endlessly, so grand,
Photos and messages, it's my daily plan,
I'm hooked, without it, I feel abandoned.
All these gadgets that create dopamine,
They spin my head, they put me in a trance,
I give them all my love, these little machines,
When they come to life, it's a party that begins.
[ solo ]
These little machines, my music alarm,
They accompany me everywhere, magical and calm,
What would my life be without their tech charm,
Long live the gadgets, my panic-free balm.
[outro]
